mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vpn_user_session (user_id, device_id, token, expire_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{token}, #{expireAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, token, expire_at, created_at FROM vpn_user_session WHERE token = #{token} AND expire_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
